title: FM
description: An exploration of FM synthesis using Ableton's Operator, working through different modulation indices and frequency ratios to hit a range of timbres and textures. The usual instruments were covered: drums, lead, pad, pluck, alongside some extra stuff just for fun.

audio.label: Mix
audio.desc: A short snippet putting all the instruments together. A bit hectic and cluttered, but maybe that was the intention... (it wasn't).

audio.label: Lead
audio.desc: The lead isolated. An aggressive, percussive voicing with velocity variation driving the dynamics.

audio.label: Drums
audio.desc: The drums isolated. Idk what else to specify, it's drums.

audio.label: Bass
audio.desc: The bass isolated. If memory serves, I wrote the tune in Phrygian after sketching out the bass part first.

audio.label: Layered Pad
audio.desc: The pad isolated. A contrasting layer built from a swelling pad with a mallet strike on the attack.

audio.label: Bells
audio.desc: You can't do FM without making bells. Not quite suited for the mix above, but a good standalone sample.

audio.label: Aux Percussion
audio.desc: Some additional percussion sounds I created with FM.
